web-guide-idea-64.audience: Job seekers who learn by practising and observing others.
web-guide-idea-64.offer: Facilitate mock answers in a small group, with constructive feedback and enough time for every participant.
web-guide-idea-64.steps.0: Choose a role or interview skill.
web-guide-idea-64.steps.1: Give each person a timed answer and feedback turn.
web-guide-idea-64.steps.2: Repeat one answer using the feedback.
web-guide-idea-64.equipment: A phone, quiet room and timer. A laptop helps with notes.
web-guide-idea-64.returnReason: Run separate sessions for introductions, examples and difficult questions.
web-guide-idea-64.promotion: Publish a sample question and the number of practice turns participants can expect. Avoid hiring guarantees.
